parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State or imply the form $\frac{A}{1+x}+\frac{Bx+C}{2+x^2}$. [B1]
Use a correct method for finding a constant. [M1]
Obtain one of $A=2$, $B=-1$ and $C=0$. [A1] Guidance: SC: A maximum of M1A1 is available for obtaining $A=2$ after scoring B0.
Obtain a second value. [A1]
Obtain the third value. [A1]
[Total: 5]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Integrate and obtain term $2\ln(1+x)$. [B1 FT] Guidance: $A\ln(1+x)$.
Integrate and obtain a term of the form $k\ln(2+x^2)$ from an integral of the correct form. [*M1] Guidance: Ignore any separate working relating to $C\ne0$.
Obtain term $-\frac12\ln(2+x^2)$. [A1 FT] Guidance: $\frac{B}{2}\ln(2+x^2)$.
Substitute limits in an integral containing terms of the form $a\ln(1+x)+b\ln(2+x^2)$, where $ab\ne0$. [DM1] Guidance: Ignore working relating to $C\ne0$. $(2\ln5-2\ln1-\frac12\ln18+\frac12\ln2)$. Dependent on the first M1. Must be subtracting the correct way round. Must have an exact substitution.
Obtain answer $\ln(\frac{25}{3})$. [A1] Guidance: ISW. Any exact equivalent, e.g. $\ln(\frac{25\sqrt2}{\sqrt{18}})$, with no number in front of the logarithm.
[Total: 5]
